text: This report recommends that the name "Mike Reid Lane" be approved to identify a public lane south of Carlton Street, extending westerly from Parliament Street then southerly to Doctor O Lane. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Mike Reid Lane" for a public lane south of Carlton Street, extending westerly from Parliament Street then southerly to Doctor O Lane.
